document.body:
Teardown findings, failed 33 kV cable joints, July to
September 2026
Failure analysis by the field service team of Raychem RPG, November 2026.
Six failed joints were cut open and checked for the four causes in the set order. Water entry was
the cause in 3 joints, a preparation error in 2 and a connector defect in 1. No joint failed from
overload. All 3 joints with water entry were installed in rain, and the work was not stopped when
rain reached the open cable.
How the teardown was done
Each failed joint stayed in place until photos were taken. It was then cut open along its length, and the
point where the fault path started was found. The four causes were checked in order: preparation error,
water entry, connector defect and overload of the circuit. This failed joint teardown followed the failure
analysis procedure of the field service team.
Findings by joint
Joint Site Months in
service
Cause What was seen
1 Substation feeder, site A 5 Water entry Water marks under the outer sleeve.
The sleeve end was not sealed.
2 Substation feeder, site A 5 Water entry Same installer team and same week
as joint 1. Moisture around the
connector.
3 Industrial plant, site B 8 Preparation error Carbon track that starts at a knife cut
in the insulation.
4 Wind farm collector line,
site C
3 Water entry Installed in rain without a tent. Water
inside the sleeve.
5 Industrial plant, site B 11 Connector defect Gap in the crimp. Heat marks on the
connector.
6 Utility feeder, site D 14 Preparation error Insulation not degreased. Tracking
along the surface.
What the job records showed
5 of the 6 joints had a digital job card. 3 of these 5 had no photo of the sealed sleeve end, and these 3
were the joints with water entry. The second engineer had signed off all 5 records. The sign-off looked at
the test readings and not at the photos.
Actions
Action Owner Due

Put the rule to stop work when rain or dust reaches the open
cable on the first page of the jointing procedure
Head of field service 30 November 2026
Make the photo of the sealed sleeve end a required field of the
digital job card, and add it to the sign-off of the second
engineer
Quality lead 15 December 2026
Hold a refresher session on cable preparation for the installer
teams of joints 3 and 6
Training lead 31 December 2026
Check the crimp tool of the installer team of joint 5 against its
calibration record
Quality lead 30 November 2026
Synthetic sample written for the RPG NeuralMesh demonstration. It is not a record of Raychem RPG.
